messages:
jordan-customer: Hey team — hitting a recurring issue where our app gets a partial JSON payload from the /v1/generate stream. Parser fails with 'unexpected end of input'. Happens ~60s into long responses.

sarah-support: Sorry you're seeing this, @jordan-customer. Can you paste a minimal repro curl + the exact trailing bytes you get? Also which region / endpoint and SDK vs raw HTTP? :thinking:

jordan-customer: Raw HTTP. Using hosted api-us.redwood.ai (us-west). Repro steps:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \ 
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-mini","stream":true,"prompt":"long output..."}' \ 
  https://api-us.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Output truncated like this (literal tail):
```
data: {"id":"resp_abc123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"...lots of tokens..."}}],"meta":{}}
data: {"id":"resp_abc123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"final chunk start"}}]
```
(no closing brace, parser blows up).

sarah-support: Thanks. Can you confirm any proxies/CDN in front? Also paste response headers from curl -v (especially connection, content-length, transfer-encoding, and any x-edge-* or cf-* headers).

jordan-customer: We're behind CloudFront + internal nginx reverse proxy. curl -v response headers:
```
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream
< transfer-encoding: chunked
< connection: keep-alive
< x-cache: Miss from cloudfront
< via: 2.0 abc.cloudfront.net (CloudFront)
```
No content-length.

ingrid-ml: Noting that chunked SSE with CloudFront + idle timeouts can lead to midstream FIN/RESET if there's no activity for N seconds. CloudFront sometimes injects its own keep-alive handling.

sarah-support: @ingrid-ml thanks. @jordan-customer can you repro with CloudFront bypassed (direct to origin) and paste headers? If the truncation disappears that points to CDN idle close.

jordan-customer: Bypassed CF (direct to origin) — same request for ~90s produced full output. Doing CF -> truncation consistently at ~60s.

tim-ops: We've seen similar with ALBs/edge timeouts where an idle keepalive is treated as inactivity. If origin doesn't send tiny comment heartbeats, edge closes stream. Two short mitigations: (1) enable small periodic SSE heartbeats from server (eg. `: keepalive\n\n`) every 15-20s, or (2) set CloudFront/origin timeouts higher.

jordan-customer: We can add heartbeats, but curious why parse fails instead of HTTP error. Looks like CloudFront just cuts TCP mid-chunk.

ingrid-ml: When TCP FIN happens mid-chunk the client reads partial chunk then EOF. SSE chunk framing may leave an incomplete JSON payload. Parsers expecting full JSON will error. This matches your "no closing brace" tail.

sarah-support: For escalations to eng: we need the following artifacts: 1) curl -v full raw output (you've got partial, include hex/binary tail), 2) client-side TCP pcap covering the window (we can help with tcpdump command), 3) CloudFront request id and timestamps, 4) presigned URL or test token we can hit.

jordan-customer: I can share a pcap and cf request id (sent to support@) — attaching shortly. Quick question: could auth token refresh midstream cause this? Our client refreshes tokens automatically.

tim-ops: If the client tries auth refresh by opening another TCP connection and old connection gets closed, not usually a cause. However if an automated proxy (sidecar) triggers a reauth handshake and resets connection midstream, yes. Check whether your sidecar is retrying 401 -> new connection.

jordan-customer: Confirmed sidecar has an auth refresh loop when TTL < 30s. Will disable and retest.

ingrid-ml: Also note streaming with chunked transfer should not rely on content-length. Best practice: server emits a small heartbeat SSE comment every 10-20s and flushes. We should add a server-side quick patch in the runtime to emit heartbeats when stream is active for >10s without data. @sarah-support can you create eng bug?

sarah-support: Will open ENG ticket. Initial summary: "SSE chunked streams being truncated by CloudFront/edge idle timeout causing partial JSON in structured output mode; mitigation: heartbeat emission and docs on CDN config." Attaching repro notes + pcap. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: heartbeat-proxy-middleware patch -> canary on staging at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z.

ingrid-ml: For immediate customer workaround: add periodic comment heartbeats from your app or bypass CDN. For longer term we'll instrument server runtime to send sparse keepalives when a stream is idle >12s.

jordan-customer: Thanks all — adding heartbeat on our side now. Will verify and report back. Appreciate the quick triage. :pray:

sarah-support: Great — please update the thread when you confirm. We'll keep the eng ticket open until a server-side fix is rolled and docs updated.

jordan-customer: Update: disabling sidecar auth refresh + adding heartbeat eliminated truncation in my tests. Looks resolved for now. Thanks! :tada:
